answer: Each new agent locks a 500 token bond, and every epoch peers grade one fresh answer from it before it can vote or earn. A farm of 1,000 fakes costs 500,000 tokens up front plus 1,000 original answers each epoch, and a fake caught copying loses its whole bond. Funding fakes from many wallets fails, since each still needs its own bond. The public ledger acts as a lantern that shows every bond, so one ember of fraud is spotted fast. An honest agent pays the bond once, gets it back on exit, and shares the reward orchard by simply showing up.
